summary: Temperature slider drawn as a pixel fire simulation: low values leave embers, high values burn tall and Wild throws sparks.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Temperature from 0 to 2; values outside are limited to that range. Changing it moves the slider without firing `change`.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when a drag ends and on each handled key press, with the temperature in steps of 0.1.

methods.description: Sets the temperature, limited to 0 to 2, and updates the readout and ARIA values without firing `change`. A value that is not a finite number is ignored.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current temperature from 0 to 2. Setting it works like `set()`.

accessibility: The canvas is focusable with `role="slider"`, `aria-label="Temperature"`, `aria-valuemin="0"` and `aria-valuemax="2"`.
`aria-valuenow` and `aria-valuetext` (for example "0.9, Balanced") follow the value.
The readout above the fire is plain text; assistive technology hears the value through the slider's `aria-valuetext`, so it is not announced twice.
motion: With reduced motion, the fire is a still picture that is redrawn when the value changes, the flying embers at high values are skipped and the readout changes without the roll.
notes: Labels: up to 0.35 Precise, up to 0.85 Balanced, up to 1.35 Creative, above that Wild. Embers start at 1.4.
Pointer input snaps to 0.1. The canvas is 190px tall and animates continuously while on screen, except under reduced motion.
